question: Which river originates south of the equator and flows north through north-eastern Africa to drain into the Mediterranean Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Nile River.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Origin:** South of the equator in **East Africa**, with the primary source being **Lake Victoria.**
 
• **Flow:** North through **northeastern Africa.**
 
• **Drainage:** Empties into the **Mediterranean Sea.**
 
• **Length:** Approximately 6,650 kilometers (4,130 miles), making it one of the **longest rivers** in the world.
 
• **Significance:** Vital for agriculture in **Egypt** and **Sudan**; historically important for ancient civilizations, especially Egypt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Congo River:**

__
 
• **Origin:** Begins in the highlands of** northeastern Zambia.**
 
• **Flow:** Flows through the **Congo Basin** in Central Africa, mostly westward.
 
• **Drainage:** Empties into the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• **Length: **About 4,700 kilometers (2,920 miles).
 
• **Significance:** **Second longest** river in Africa; major transportation route in the Congo Basin.

​**Amazon River:**

 
• **Origin:** Originates in the **Andes Mountains **of Peru.
 
• **Flow:** Flows eastward across northern South America.
 
• **Drainage:** Empties into the **Atlantic Ocean**.
 
• **Length:** Approximately 7,000 kilometers (4,350 miles), **considered the longest river by some measurements**.
 
• **Significance:** Largest river by discharge volume of water; vital to the Amazon rainforest ecosystem.

**Lena River:**

 
• **Origin:** Originates in the **Baikal Mountains** of Siberia, Russia.
 
• **Flow:** Flows northward across Siberia.
 
• **Drainage:** Empties into the Arctic Ocean.
 
• **Length: **About 4,400 kilometers (2,736 miles).
 
• **Significance:** One of the major rivers in **Russia**; important for **Arctic navigation** and regional ecology. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** [IMAGE: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/317372179/figure/fig4/AS:667934481469447@1536259398320/Map-showing-the-Nile-River-with-its-main-branches-White-and-Blue-Niles-and-the-site-of.png] 

**Map Description of the Nile River:**

 
• **Source:**

 
 
• **Lake Victoria:** The Nile's primary source is **Lake Victoria**, located in East Africa.
 
• **Other Important Sources: The Blue Nile**, originating from Lake Tana in Ethiopia, also contributes significantly to the Nile’s flow.
 
 
 
• **Course:**
 
 
• **Northward Flow:** The Nile flows northward through Uganda, then enters Sudan.
 
• **Egyptian Stretch:** It continues through Egypt, passing through major cities such as** Cairo.**
 
 
 
• **Delta:**
 
 
• **Nile Delta:** The river fans out into the Nile Delta before draining into the Mediterranean Sea.
 
 
 
• It has historically been considered the **longest river in the world**, though this has been contested by research suggesting that the **Amazon River** is slightly longer.
